captions.detailed: This 3D model features a slant-top casino cabinet with a matte black outer shell and a base stand. It includes a prominent angled display screen, a small horizontal button deck, and a lockable dark gray belly door at the bottom. The belly door is equipped with a silver lock and rotates on a vertical side hinge, while a bright red spin button on the deck translates vertically, and a small volume knob near the screen rotates continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a slant-top casino machine with a black cabinet, an angled screen, a button deck, and a lower belly door. Incorporate a revolute joint for the belly door, a prismatic joint for a red spin button, and a continuous rotational joint for a volume knob.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly starting with a main cabinet base using a box primitive. It models the angled screen frame and panel, a horizontal button deck, and a lower belly door using box primitives. A cylindrical red button is created on the deck, and a small cylinder represents the volume knob. These components are organized into parts with materials, and articulated via a revolute joint for the belly door, a prismatic joint for the spin button, and a continuous joint for the volume knob.
